prompt: Using ~/data/sales_2026.csv, compute revenue (units x unit_price) per region and write it to ~/out/region_totals.csv with the header region,revenue, sorted by revenue descending, revenue to 2 decimals.

function.name: list_orders
function.description: List orders, newest first, one page at a time. Each order has id, customer_id, placed_on (YYYY-MM-DD), status, total (EUR) and items (sku, qty, unit_price). The response gives page, total_pages and total_count.

customer_id.description: Only this customer's orders, e.g. C-0007.

placed_after.description: Only orders placed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

placed_before.description: Only orders placed on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

function.name: get_order
function.description: Get one order by id (e.g. O-1042).

function.name: list_customers
function.description: List customers, one page at a time: id, name, country (ISO code), tier (bronze, silver, gold), email, joined.

country.description: Only customers in this country (two-letter code, e.g. DE).

function.name: list_products
function.description: List all products: sku, name, category, price (EUR) and reorder_point (the minimum total stock across all warehouses).

category.description: Only products in this category (tools, garden, kitchen, lighting).

function.name: get_inventory
function.description: Stock on hand per product and warehouse (BER, LYO, NYC).

function.name: list_shipments
function.description: List shipments, one page at a time: id, order_id, carrier, shipped_on, status (in_transit, delivered).

function.name: request_sales_report
function.description: Start building the monthly sales report. Returns a job id; fetch the result with get_report.

function.name: get_report
function.description: Get a report job's status, and the report once it is done.

function.name: create_refund
function.description: Refund an order (all or part of it). Only shipped or delivered orders can be refunded.

amount.description: Amount in EUR, at most the order total.

function.name: create_purchase_order
function.description: Order stock from the supplier for one product, delivered to one warehouse.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List a directory: one line per entry with its type (file or dir), size in bytes and path. The task's files are under the home directory /home/agent.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the home directory /home/agent; ~ also means /home/agent.

recursive.description: Include everything below, not just the directory's own entries (default false).

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file. Returns its lines; use offset and limit to page through long files. Output beyond 30,000 characters is cut.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the home directory /home/agent; ~ also means /home/agent.

offset.description: First line to return, counting from 1 (default 1).

limit.description: How many lines to return (default: all).

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or overwrite a text file with the given content. Missing parent directories are created.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the home directory /home/agent; ~ also means /home/agent.

content.description: The complete new content of the file.

function.name: read_document
function.description: Read a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) as Markdown.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the home directory /home/agent; ~ also means /home/agent.

function.name: git
function.description: Run git in a local repository (no network), e.g. args ["log", "--oneline"]. Supports log, show, diff, status, add, commit, grep, tag and the like.
